question: In the push-response context, does replaying the C arms' unpushed coxa command time series open loop (no neural coxa loop) reproduce the C arms' amplified fore-aft push response?
not_an_admission_test: No coordinate status changes from any outcome.

sources.reference_note: push-response raw arms N{0,F,B}_s and C{0,F,B}_s (local, uncommitted); C0_s is the yoke source; none is rerun
sources.method_origin: malecns_backend/live/tibia_command_dissection.py selected_action / TibiaTrial.apply (sim.step wrapped at bind; proposed and applied recorded); index set substituted; tibia module unchanged

yoke.source: push-response C0_s of the same seed
yoke.convention: outgoing transition n applies source samples[n+1]['commanded_joints'] at the four indices; other 38 coordinates exactly as proposed
yoke.configuration: N (Step C A_ON, 20 v3 channels, no hypothesis channel, no label)

disturbance: identical to the push-response protocol: Thorax COM, world frame, zero torque, outgoing transitions 5000-5199, F [+1.024,0,0], B [-1.024,0,0], 0 none

integrity.I2_sources_verified: push-response report sha matches; the 18 reference arms hash to the report values
integrity.I3_reproduces_c0: Y0_s equals push-response C0_s over the whole run: every sample's qpos and applied commands (all 42); every tick's fired, uniforms and hair deliveries
integrity.I4_common_rng: every Y arm's per-tick uniforms and external schedule equal N0_s
integrity.I5_yoke_audit: every transition: applied equals proposed with indices 0/7/14/28 replaced by the source's sample n+1 values; other 38 equal proposed; v3 inventory equals N0_s; no hypothesis channel or label
integrity.I7_prefixes_seeds: YF_s/YB_s equal Y0_s through physics index 5000 (qpos, applied commands) and ticks at or before 500 ms; every arm records its seed

pulse_precondition: already established in the push-response run (NF_s, NB_s resolved in every seed and direction); not re-tested

measures.D: coxa_push_response.deviation_integral of tactile_recovery_metrics.trace, states 5201..20000, model mm * s; Y arms vs Y0_s; N and C references vs N0_s and C0_s, recomputed from raw arms
reported: C-arm loop modulation: mean |c(Cp_s)-c(C0_s)| per coxa index over the cleared window and count of differing transitions

labels.OFFSETS_REPRODUCE: R_Y >= 1.10 in all 3 seeds and 0.90 <= E <= 1.10 in all 3 seeds
labels.OFFSETS_PARTLY_REPRODUCE: R_Y >= 1.10 in all 3 seeds and E outside [0.90, 1.10] in >= 1 seed
labels.bar_note: 10 % inherited engineering resolution from the push-response test; no noise estimate for E

consequence_declared_in_advance: OFFSETS_REPRODUCE: amplification explained by the open-loop setpoint schedule; push-time loop response not needed (this pulse and posture). PARTLY: posture amplifies but removing push-time modulation changes D > 10 % in some seed (direction reported). DO_NOT: fixed setpoints alone do not amplify; the push-response mechanism reading was wrong or incomplete. No channel, weight, threshold, gain, magnitude or seed changes; no status changes; coverage stays 20/42 admitted, +4 conditional.
interpretation_limits: The archived commands are neural output: the yoke removes only push-time loop response, not the loops' pre-push history.
One engineering pulse and three seeds, inherited.
E has no noise estimate; post-push chaotic divergence can move D without a causal role for loop modulation.
Reference arms are local; evaluation depends on their verified hashes.
